BETA.changelog:
V4.10.0

Overview

This release introduces Mesh, GL.iNet Account, and native VLAN support. It also improves GoodCloud account management and VPN cascading.

New Features

Mesh: Adds EasyMesh-compliant networking using local Mesh Nodes.

GL.iNet Account: Introduces a centralized profile page for viewing and managing GL.iNet account services.

VLAN: Adds IEEE 802.1Q native VLAN support to improve network segmentation and isolation.

Optimizations & Enhancements

GoodCloud: Streamlines the account binding process and adds an option to clear cloud account data during a factory reset.

VPN: Adds IP address and DNS conflict detection for cascaded VPN configurations.

RELEASE.changelog:
V4.8.3

Overview

This version introduces several new features and enhancements that improve the interface interaction for the overall user experience.

New Features

Added VPN multi-instance to support enabling multiple VPN clients simultaneously.

Added VPN composite policy, allowing traffic diversion based on multiple criteria, including source interface, source MAC address, and destination domain/IP.

Added an option to enable or disable VPN internet access on the Clients page, which is effective only when the VPN policy is based on MAC.

Added the isolation feature between the Guest Network and the Upstream network.

Added support for HTTPS in RTTY.
